segments.name: manufacture and distribution of TCMP
segments.description: Manufactures and distributes Chinese traditional medicine products (TCMP) sold mainly to hospitals and pharmaceutical distributors in China.
segments.evidence: In the respective periods presented, the Company had one single operating and reportable segment, namely the manufacture and distribution of TCMP.

revenueModel.text: Hospitals, mainly TCM hospitals in Jiangsu province, pay the company for TCMP products.
revenueModel.evidence: Our major customers are hospitals, especially TCM hospitals, primarily in the Jiangsu province in China.
